=== Proof Status ===

1 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] Weighted minimum bound: let p_1, ..., p_m be positive reals with sum_i p_i = 1 and let n_1, ..., n_m be real numbers; then min over i in {1, ..., m} of n_i <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
  1.1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] The index set {1, ..., m} is nonempty and finite, hence mu := min over i in {1,...,m} of n_i exists and is attained.
  1.2 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] For every i in {1, ..., m}, mu <= n_i.
    1.2.1 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] mu is defined as min over i in {1, ..., m} of n_i, i.e. mu is the least element of the finite set S = {n_1, ..., n_m}.
    1.2.2 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] By definition of the minimum of a set, mu is a lower bound for S: for every x in S, mu <= x.
    1.2.3 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] For every i in {1, ..., m}, n_i is an element of S.
    1.2.4 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] For every i in {1, ..., m}, mu <= n_i.
  1.3 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] For every i in {1, ..., m}, p_i * mu <= p_i * n_i.
    1.3.1 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] Fix an arbitrary i in {1, ..., m}.
    1.3.2 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] mu <= n_i.
    1.3.3 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] p_i > 0, hence in particular p_i >= 0.
    1.3.4 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] p_i * mu <= p_i * n_i.
    1.3.5 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] Since i was arbitrary, for every i in {1, ..., m}, p_i * mu <= p_i * n_i.
  1.4 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i * mu <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
    1.4.1 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] For every i in {1, ..., m}, the termwise inequality p_i * mu <= p_i * n_i holds.
    1.4.2 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] If a_i <= b_i for all i in a finite index set I, then sum over i in I of a_i <= sum over i in I of b_i.
    1.4.3 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] Instantiate the finite-sum monotonicity principle with I = {1, ..., m}, a_i = p_i * mu, b_i = p_i * n_i.
    1.4.4 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i * mu <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
  1.5 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i * mu = mu * sum_i p_i = mu * 1 = mu.
  1.6 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] mu <= sum_i p_i * n_i, i.e. min over i in {1,...,m} of n_i <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
    1.6.1 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i * mu <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
    1.6.2 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i * mu = mu * sum_i p_i.
    1.6.3 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i = 1, hence mu * sum_i p_i = mu * 1 = mu.
    1.6.4 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i * mu = mu.
    1.6.5 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] mu <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
    1.6.6 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] mu = min over i in {1,...,m} of n_i, hence min over i in {1,...,m} of n_i <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
